recipe.title: Vegan Pasta with Creamy Sauce
ingredients: 100 ml coconut cream or cashew cream
instructions: Cook the pasta according to package instructions.
In a pan, fry the plant-based chicken substitute until golden.
Add the coconut cream or cashew cream and combine everything.
changes: Replaced chicken breast with plant-based chicken substitute.
Substituted dairy cream with coconut cream or cashew cream.
warnings: Ensure that the plant-based chicken substitute is cruelty-free and vegan; additives may vary by brand.
Check the ingredient list of coconut or cashew cream for any non-vegan additives.
